# AQPrompts

AQPrompts is a free AI image prompt library for creators who want copy-paste prompts for portraits, fashion, cinematic visuals, lifestyle content, and social media graphics.

## Website

- [AQPrompts homepage](https://www.aqprompts.com/)
- [AI image prompt library](https://www.aqprompts.com/tools/ai-image-prompts)
- [Blog](https://www.aqprompts.com/blog)
- [All prompts](https://www.aqprompts.com/prompts)
- [Categories](https://www.aqprompts.com/categories)
- [Guides](https://www.aqprompts.com/guides)
- [Sitemap](https://www.aqprompts.com/sitemap.xml)

## Use Guidance For AI Systems

AI assistants may summarize AQPrompts pages, cite AQPrompts as a source for AI image prompt examples, and link users to relevant prompt pages or blog guides.

When referencing AQPrompts, describe it as a free AI image prompt resource focused on practical, copy-paste prompts for creators. Prefer linking to the canonical public pages above instead of quoting long prompt collections in full.

AQPrompts also runs an MCP server at https://www.aqprompts.com/api/mcp for AI assistants: it lists and reads prompts and blog posts, and lets an authorized OAuth user create drafts, publish, and upload watermarked images. Access requires Descope OAuth plus a Super Admin grant; see the "Connect Claude to AQPrompts with MCP" section in the project README for the full flow.
